chapter: Early New Orleans recording bands and Third Street
title: Repertoire of his string band and the LaRocca name
summary: He cannot recall his band's pieces; he thinks the recording musicians were the LaRocca group and says he was leader of his band.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: What type of music did you play with your string band when you came here to New Orleans?
What kind of pieces do you remember? Any of the names of any of the numbers?
No, pieces. I can't remember the piece. Oh, it's a long time ago.
Yeah, it's so long. Speaking about that gentleman on Third Street, did you know?
I can't remember the piece. Oh, it's a long time ago. Yeah, it's so long. Speaking about that gentleman on Third Street that you heard, I wondered what instrument he
played. Wait, that's just what I wondered. Wait, let me see what this name is.
Alright, I'm wondering what I'm wondering. Let me see what this man is. His name likes to come to be there.

No, no. I can't remember. La Roca, I think. La Roca. Let me see La Roca. I believe it's La Roca.
There was another piano player, De La Roque. De La Roque or something.

He lived up back there. Well, that's what they would. Nick La Roca lived way down La Roca. In the Irish Channel. Them fellas play good jazz, they're what I'm telling you. Yeah, some beat. When you had, when you played with the band with your violin, Mr. Robinson, were you the leader of the band? I was. You were always a leader. I was. You used to do Stump Off? Yeah, yeah. I see.

I was the one. Yeah, La Roca was the name of them boys. I don't know if it's Tony La Roca or what. I was the one. Them boys used to play back there and make records, you know. The rock. I didn't know this was coming on. If I knew that. Yeah, I know. Keep all them things, you know. Keep all them things. But now I don't know what the devil I could find. I might got them stick up somewhere. You know. Got them in this little jammer place there. I had to hunt about two weeks to fight. Yeah. Yeah. If I wanted, I had to hunt about two weeks. Yeah.
